What it represents: A workflow running in the cloud; automated, instant or scheduled
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview; Dataverse for solution-based flow records
Logging and auditing coverage: Purview: creation, edits, deletion and permission changes. Dataverse: changes to audited Workflows and Connection Reference records for solution flows.
Additional execution / operational evide: Cloud-flow run history; Dataverse FlowRun for solution flows; Application Insights where supported. Purview lifecycle auditing does not provide individual run/action details.

What it represents: Automation that interacts with desktop applications or websites
Logging and auditing coverage: Changes to enabled desktop-flow tables and columns, including Desktop Flow Module and Desktop Flow Binary.
Additional execution / operational evide: Desktop-flow run history, Flow Session records and action logs. Configuration auditing and execution logging are separate requirements.

What it represents: A configured connection to a service using an authentication identity
Logging and auditing coverage: Connection creation, updates, deletion and sharing-permission changes; documented data-policy disablement event.
Additional execution / operational evide: Flow run/action errors and destination-service audit logs establish usage. A Dataverse connection reference is a separate object pointing to a connection.

What it represents: A reusable definition for accessing a custom API
Logging and auditing coverage: Custom API creation, modification, deletion, sharing-permission changes and movement into a solution.
Additional execution / operational evide: Flow action results and API/gateway access logs. Configuration auditing is not a complete API transaction log.

What it represents: A registered computer used to execute desktop flows
Logging and auditing coverage: Changes to audited Flow Machine records and supported fields.
Additional execution / operational evide: Desktop-flow sessions and machine status; Windows, endpoint and application logs provide host-level evidence.

What it represents: A group of machines available to execute desktop flows
Logging and auditing coverage: Changes to audited Flow Machine Group records and relevant machine relationships where supported.
Additional execution / operational evide: Group run queues and desktop-flow sessions show execution allocation and outcomes. Configuration auditing alone does not establish availability.

What it represents: A Microsoft-hosted machine for desktop automation
Primary audit source: Microsoft Dataverse; selected hosted-RPA events in Purview
Logging and auditing coverage: Changes to applicable audited machine, image and network records. Purview also documents hosted-RPA Entra ID join events.
Additional execution / operational evide: Hosted-machine status and desktop-flow run/action logs. Validate which configuration fields are auditable.

What it represents: A group of Microsoft-hosted machines for desktop automation
Primary audit source: Microsoft Dataverse; selected hosted-RPA events in Purview
Logging and auditing coverage: Changes to applicable audited machine-group, machine, image and network records. Coverage depends on enabled tables and columns.
Additional execution / operational evide: Hosted-group monitoring, queued runs and desktop-flow sessions. Retain group and executing-machine identifiers because bots are provisioned dynamically.

What it represents: Business records stored in Dataverse and processed by automations
Logging and auditing coverage: Record creation, modification and deletion in supported tables. Enable auditing at environment, table and column levels.
Additional execution / operational evide: Correlate affected records with flow runs to connect data changes to automation execution.

What it represents: Access to, retrieval of or export of Dataverse data
Logging and auditing coverage: Supported access/read/export activity. Configure separately; ordinary Dataverse change auditing does not cover retrieve/export operations.
Additional execution / operational evide: Correlate activity with identity and flow-run evidence to investigate access and data movement.

What it represents: Administration of environments, settings and connector restrictions
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview — Power Platform admin activity
Logging and auditing coverage: Supported environment lifecycle, settings and data-policy changes. Admin activity collection is enabled by default and cannot be disabled.
Additional execution / operational evide: Correlate administrative changes with affected flows, connections and subsequent failures or policy enforcement.
